note: One row per promise in the live bounty text. status is one of unrecorded / kept / broken / na. Set it BY HAND with evidence - a terminal cannot see a post. Regenerating preserves what you set.

promises.text: Cut that session into one vertical video, under 90 seconds, that credits Star 97.7, sends people to ZAOstock on Saturday, and is ready to post to Instagram as it is.
Credit Star 97.7 on screen, by name, for long enough to read.
Not required, and it never disqualifies you, but /zao is where the entries get seen next to each other, and it is how you get notes back before the close.
That is the test for the credit and for the taste.
Every submitter earns $ZABAL automatically through the POIDH Submitters leaderboard on Empire Builder, and the drop scales with how many BCZ rounds you have entered in total.
Everyone who enters gets a note back on their piece, win or lose.
